page.notes: Doubtful readings: "consecratum" (first letters faint, read as confecratum in print), "mortaliūsum" (tilde and letters unclear). The italic/roman division in the superscription is partly unclear; "Johanni Morino" and "Bartholdus Nihusius" read as roman there. The subject line is treated as a level 2 title. The running head is printed in small capitals and is reproduced in capitals.
